findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Stubs in Research Commands

evidence.observation: Multiple Phase 5 TODO comments indicating uncompleted authorization checks and memory integrations

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase authorization checks and decision_to_memory integration in research_commands.py

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures proper authorization checking and integration with memory subsystems

findings.title: Unimplemented Quality Anomalies Query in Forecasting

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO comment: 'Query quality_anomalies table'

proposed_action.description: Query the quality_anomalies table instead of returning an empty list

findings.expected_benefit: Enables accurate quality forecasting based on actual historical anomaly data

findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocations Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using raw API keys instead of routing through model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency_alerts.py to use the centralized model router instead of calling provider APIs directly

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains unified telemetry, fallback management, and rate limiting across LLM invocations

findings.title: Model Router Call Log File Missing

evidence.observation: Router status indicates call_log_exists is false for configured log path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and writes routing events to the call_log.jsonl file

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into routing latency, model execution metrics, and failure rates
